values.note: recreation.gov 2026-2028 peak season: non-electric $24, electric $33; double sites $40 / $52. First-come season from November: non-electric $10, electric $15, self-service pay station. Second vehicle $8 a day. Pass discounts don't apply to the electric part.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232027/rates (peak seasons 2026, 2027, 2028 and the first-come season 2026-11-01 to 12-31) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/indian-celina-lakes-recreation-area (non-peak $10 / $15) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/193896, read 2026-10-31

values.note: The Forest Service guide gives 63 including four doubles; recreation.gov lists 59. On recreation.gov 54 of the 59 allow an RV of 23 ft or more, nearly all to 35 ft; South Slope 011-013 allow tents only, 021-022 cap at 20 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/193896 ('a total of 63 campsites, including four double sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232027 (per-site permitted equipment), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232027 (31 sites Electricity Hookup 30; the only 15-amp sites are the tents-only ones), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Flush restrooms and showers only in the main season (early April to late October); vault toilets the rest of the year.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/indian-celina-lakes-recreation-area ('Modern flush restrooms available during camping season. Vault toilets available year-round.' 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232027 ('Accessible flush toilets, showers and drinking water'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: North Face is open all year. South Slope closes at the end of deer firearm season (November 30 at noon this year) and reopens in early April.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/indian-celina-lakes-recreation-area ('North Face campsites are open all year with limited services November through March'; 'Southslope camping loop open until November 30 at noon'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservable early April to late October; first-come at self-service pay stations the rest of the year. Unreserved sites may go to walk-ups within three days. recreation.gov's rule is an 11-month window; the Forest Service guide still says nine months.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232027 (facility_rules: reservationWindow 11 Months, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/indian-celina-lakes-recreation-area ('Some sites are only non-reservabe'; 'Campsites are first-come, first-served' in winter), read 2026-10-31

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/indian-celina-lakes-recreation-area ('Interagency Access, Senior and Military-Lifetime pass holders can receive discounts on base camping fees'), read 2026-10-31

note: Hoosier NF, between Celina and Indian Lakes. Two loops about 500 m apart off one gatehouse: South Slope all electric, North Face mostly non-electric. Sites set back in the woods, not waterfront. Run by a concessionaire, BA Services, early April to late October. --Claude
summary: $24-33, 63 sites, 30A, showers/flush confirmed; added max rig 35, season year-round (North Face), 14-night max, 11-month window, doubles and winter rates; note cleaned. Pin 1.4 km off, across SR 37.
flags: PIN: 1.4 km off, east of SR 37. Stored 38.1925,-86.5910. recreation.gov's site points (27 of 59 have GPS) centre South Slope on 38.19264,-86.60844 and North Face on 38.19717,-86.60612; imagery shows both loops there. Correct to 38.1953,-86.6071 (between the two, weighted by sites).
NO SPLIT: the two loops are about 540 m apart, both reached from one gatehouse on SR 37 (FS: 'A gatehouse sits just off State Road 37 at the entrance').

WATER: not waterfront stands. On imagery the nearest South Slope sites are about 430 m from the nearest arm of Celina Lake, North Face about 1 km, wooded ridge between. Imagery estimates; Overpass did not answer.
PHONE: stored empty. FS guide and recreation.gov give campground staff 812-843-4880; the FS page gives concessionaire BA Services 812-837-9453; Tell City office 812-547-7051. Use 812-843-4880.
OPERATOR: BA Services, Inc. runs it under a Forest Service permit but it books on recreation.gov, inside the federal system.
FIT: recreation.gov permits RV on 54 of 59 sites at 23 ft or more; 011-013 are tents only though typed electric and 021-022 cap at 20 ft. No criteria problem. FS site list shows spurs of 38-63 ft.

CONFLICT: recreation.gov lists all 59 as reservable; the FS guide marks most North Face sites and many South Slope sites 'May be Reserved: No'. The guide also says 9-month window (recreation.gov 11 months). The FS page says 'first-come' only for the winter schedule.
